stage: Stage 0 of the 10-stock behavioural engine: is there persistent stock-specific intraday behaviour at all?
status: Declared before any real-data run. No change after results are seen. A second run of this declaration is stamped RERUN and is not fresh evidence.
question: For simple same-day setups, do the stocks that did best in H1 (relative to their own plain open-to-close trade) also do best in H2, more than chance allows after correcting for 20 setup-sides, AND do the H1 top-decile stocks make money after costs in H2?
not_retested: BIGMOVE v1.1 (opening-range breakouts with rankings and gates) and BIGMOVE v2 (trap reversal, breakout retest, late coil, exhaustion fade, 10:30 RS leader; NIFTY trap / pullback / coil) are dead and are not retested as pooled strategies. Stage 0 asks a different question: whether per-stock results PERSIST. Plain opening-range, gap, VWAP, first-hour, compression and previous-day-level setups are used only as probes of that.

data.bars: <SYMBOL>_3m.parquet in intraday_cache.store(root) (bar start, IST, 09:15-15:27, 125 bars); only sessions that pass intraday_cache v1.7 reconcile_symbol against the daily cache; a session is usable when its first bar exists and at least 80% of its bars exist (bigmove_study v1.1 usable_sessions)
data.daily: the daily cache (data_quality._paths) for liquidity, ATR(14) and the previous day's high, low and close (bigmove_study v1.1 daily_features)
data.cutoff: nothing after 2024-12-31 is used: daily rows and 3-minute bars after the H2 end are dropped right after reading, before any feature, reconciliation or count

universe.point_in_time: bigmove_study v1.1 liquid_ok: at the previous close, price at least Rs 50, 20-session median traded value at least Rs 25 crore, ATR(14) known; equity series only (no index, no ETF by name rule, INF ISIN or ETF list file in <root>\sectors\)
universe.same_day: usable 3-minute session; a previous daily row exists; ATR(14) at the previous close > 0
universe.basis_guard: a stock-day whose open is more than 20% from the previous daily close is dropped (a split-basis mismatch between files, not a tradeable gap)
universe.size: all liquid stocks with usable sessions (about 1,000), not a preselected 10

periods.untouched: 2025-01-01 onward is not read into any number

trade_rules.entry: a setup's signal is complete at the CLOSE of its signal bar k; entry at the open of the next bar that exists (k+1, or later if bars are missing), no later than the 14:30 bar; else no trade
trade_rules.exit: one plain time exit: the open of the 15:03 bar (if missing, the next open that exists, else the last close before it) - bigmove_study v1.1 time_exit_price. No stops, no targets
trade_rules.frequency: at most one trade per stock, day and setup-side (the first signal)
trade_rules.long_short: every setup has a long side and a short side, judged separately (20 setup-sides)
trade_rules.costs: Zerodha cash intraday (MIS) 4.49 bp a round trip at Rs 5 lakh (bigmove_study v1.1 cash_cost_bps), plus slippage 5 bp at entry and 3 bp at the time exit = 12.49 bp per trade. (Stop slippage 5 bp is not used: Stage 0 has no stops.)
trade_rules.plain_trade: the same-direction plain trade on every usable liquid stock-day: buy (long) or sell short (short) at the session's first open, exit at the same 15:03 time exit, the same 12.49 bp costs

bars_note: bar k starts at 09:15 + 3k minutes and closes 3 minutes later. ATR below is ATR(14) at the previous close as a fraction of price; PDH / PDL / PDC are the previous day's high / low / close from the daily cache; O0 is the session's first open; C_k the close of bar k; the opening range is bars 0-4 (09:15-09:30).

ORC.name: opening-range continuation
ORC.long: first bar k in 5..104 that closes above the 09:15-09:30 high
ORC.short: first bar k in 5..104 that closes below the 09:15-09:30 low

ORF.name: opening-range failure
ORF.long: after the first close below the opening-range low (bar 5..103), the first later close back above it (up to bar 104)
ORF.short: after the first close above the opening-range high, the first later close back below it

GAPC.name: gap continuation
GAPC.long: gap = O0 / PDC - 1 at least +0.2 ATR and C_4 > O0 (the first 15 minutes hold the gap): signal bar 4, entry 09:30
GAPC.short: gap at most -0.2 ATR and C_4 < O0

GAPF.name: gap fade
GAPF.long: gap at most -0.2 ATR and C_4 > O0 (the gap down is being bought): signal bar 4, entry 09:30
GAPF.short: gap at least +0.2 ATR and C_4 < O0

VWR.name: VWAP-stretch reversion
VWR.long: first bar k in 10..100 whose close is at least 0.4 ATR below the session VWAP (C_k / VWAP_k - 1 <= -0.4 ATR)
VWR.short: first bar k in 10..100 whose close is at least 0.4 ATR above VWAP

FHM.name: first-hour momentum to the close
FHM.long: C_19 / O0 - 1 at least +0.25 ATR at 10:15: signal bar 19, entry 10:15

CMP.name: compression then break
CMP.long: the 10:15-11:15 box (bars 20-39, at least 16 of 20 bars present) is narrow - its range (box high - box low) / PDC is at or below the 30th percentile of the stock's own box ranges over its previous 60 usable sessions (at least 40 present; today never counts) - then the first bar k in 40..104 that closes above the box high
CMP.short: the same narrow box, then the first close below the box low

PDB.name: previous-day level break
PDB.long: O0 below PDH, then the first bar k in 0..104 that closes above PDH
PDB.short: O0 above PDL, then the first close below PDL

PDR.name: previous-day level rejection
PDR.long: after the first close below PDL (bar 0..103), the first later close back above PDL (up to bar 104)
PDR.short: after the first close above PDH, the first later close back below PDH

VSF.name: volume-spike follow-through
VSF.long: first bar k in 5..100 with volume at least 3x the mean volume of the same bar slot over the stock's previous 20 usable sessions (at least 10 present) and C_k > open of bar k
VSF.short: the same spike with C_k < open of bar k

measure.per_stock: for each stock, setup-side and half: mean net return per trade (bp) minus the mean net return of the same-direction plain trade over all the stock's usable liquid days in that half (the 'excess'). The costs are the same per trade, so they cancel in the excess; they do not cancel in the pass rule's H2 test
measure.why_excess: subtracting the stock's own plain trade removes its open-to-close drift in that half, so a stock that simply trended all period does not look like it has a setup-specific behaviour
measure.min_trades: a stock enters a setup-side's persistence test only with at least 30 trades in H1 AND at least 30 in H2

persistence_test.statistic: Spearman rank correlation (average ranks for ties) across stocks between H1 excess and H2 excess, per setup-side
persistence_test.null: permutation: the H2 values are shuffled across stocks (stock labels broken) 10,000 times; one-sided p = (1 + number of shuffles with rho >= observed) / (1 + 10,000)
persistence_test.min_stocks: a setup-side with fewer than 30 eligible stocks is not testable and gets p = 1
persistence_test.multiplicity: Holm correction over all 20 declared setup-sides (untestable ones count), family-wise alpha 0.05

pass_rule.rule: PASS if at least one setup-side has Holm-adjusted p <= 0.05 AND, for that same setup-side, the H1 top-decile stocks are positive after costs in H2: the 95% block-bootstrap interval of their H2 net return is above zero
pass_rule.top_decile: among stocks with at least 30 H1 trades in that setup-side, the top 10% by H1 excess (rounded up; ties by symbol); ALL their H2 trades in that setup-side count (H2 trade counts are not used to choose them)
pass_rule.h2_series: one value per H2 day with at least one such trade: the mean net return (after the 12.49 bp) of that day's trades; circular block bootstrap over those days, blocks of 10, 2,000 resamples, seed 7; at least 20 days needed, else the leg fails
pass_rule.otherwise: report 'no persistent stock-specific behaviour' and stop

shortlist.when: only if the run PASSES, only for the setup-sides that pass both legs
shortlist.rule: stocks with at least 30 trades in each half, ranked by excess over the whole of 2021-10-01 to 2024-12-31 (all their trades pooled, minus their plain trade over the same days); the top 20 per setup-side are listed as candidates for the 10. Nothing from 2025 onward is used

reported_not_rules: per setup-side and half, all stocks pooled: trades, win rate, net bp per trade
the plain open-to-15:03 long trade's own persistence: Spearman of each stock's H1 vs H2 plain net (how much intraday drift persists by itself)

per setup-side, Spearman of H1 excess with the stock's mean H1 ATR: a high value means the persistence may be mostly volatility (a market-wide effect that is bigger in bp on volatile stocks), not a stock personality
usable share of liquid stock-days in H1 and H2 after reconciliation and the 80% rule
limitations_stated_in_report: In-sample screen only: H1 and H2 are both inside 2021-10 to 2024-12; a PASS earns a Stage 1 build, not money. 2025 onward stays untouched for later confirmation

A setup that enters later in the day keeps a small part of the stock's drift in its excess (it skips the morning part of the plain trade); with about 60 trades per stock per half this is small next to the noise, and the H2 leg judges net money, not the excess
Costs are assumed (slippage not measured); the time exit is fixed at 15:03 for every setup
One permutation per setup-side; the shuffles are not shared across setup-sides, so the Holm correction does not use their correlation (conservative)
outputs: writes only <root>\research2\stage0\S0_<date>_<n>\ (report.md, summary.json, persistence.csv, per_stock.csv, pooled.csv, shortlist.csv when it passes, outputs.sha256) and appends one line to <root>\panel\research_ledger.jsonl
